title: Civil Judge (Junior Division)
qualification: A person who is not a citizen of India, or who is dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from Judicial Service or any service of the Government, Statutory or Local Authority. || A person convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, or arrested in connection with any such crime. || A person permanently debarred or disqualified by the High Court, UPSC or any State Public Service Commission from examinations or selections. || A person who directly or indirectly influences the recruitment authority for his/her candidature. || A person having more than one wife living, or a woman who marries knowingly a person having a wife. || A candidate who has committed copying or misconduct in a Screening Test/Written Examination, or could not successfully complete the probation period of any post in Judicial Service or other service. || An officer found to be of doubtful integrity in any year.
salary: The pay and stipend details given in the notification are as follows: || Pay Scale:Rs. 77,840 - 1,36,520 for Civil Judge (Junior Division). || Training Period (1 year at the Judicial Academy):Selected candidates are designated as "Trainee Judicial Officers" and are paid a fixed emolument equivalent to one-half of the remuneration payable to a Civil Judge (Junior Division), along with the facilities and benefits ordinarily available to trainees in the Academy. || Law Clerkship (1 year):After the training, Trainee Judicial Officers undergo one year of structured Law Clerkship, with the same emoluments as during their training and no further allowance. The first six months are under the supervision of the Principal District/District and Sessions Judges or Members of the Higher Judicial Services, and the remaining six months under an Hon'ble Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. || Regular Appointment:On completion of the Law Clerkship, the Hon'ble Judge places a reasoned evaluation report. If found satisfactory, the Trainee Judicial Officer is appointed to the regular post and is entitled to the regular pay scale and other service benefits.
